sensitivity.method: Home-weighted, development-level annualised rates: for each development with a URA homes count, resales in the window x 12 / the months it was resellable in the window (from its first resale, capped at the window; at least 12 months required); then the sum of annualised resales / the sum of homes x 100. Larger developments therefore weigh more. The 12-month headline (4.1) is 484 / 11,753 directly. The windows are sensitivities, not the headline, and are not compared with the Singapore 12-month figure.

liquidity.numerator: 484 resales, 2025-10 to 2026-09, in the 21 developments with a URA homes count

reconciliation.explanation: C020141 lists three dwelling categories (HDB dwellings, condominium & other apartments, landed properties). Its Total (column "Total1/") also covers households in dwelling types the table does not list; SingStat's footnote 1/ is not reproduced in the stored record. Each figure is separately rounded to the nearest 100 (SingStat: "may not add up due to rounding"), so rounding accounts for at most 200 of the gap and at least 300 households are in the unlisted category.

insights.text: Tampines has about 87,400 HDB flats and 17,400 private homes: 5 HDB flats for every private home.
insights.qualifier: Counts of homes, not of buyers.
insights.period: HDB as at 2026-10-08; URA records to 2026-02-26

insights.text: Tampines condos resell about 1.7 times as often as its HDB flats: 4.1 vs 2.4 homes per 100 a year (Singapore 3.5 vs 2.2).
insights.qualifier: Partly lifted by one recently completed development; 3.8 without them.

insights.text: Tampines ranks 5th of 35 planning areas for condo resale activity. Excluding one recently completed development, it ranks joint 3rd.
insights.qualifier: Resale activity does not establish selling time or price performance. Both rankings are given because one recently completed development lifts Tampines's headline rate.

rank.rule: areas with 1,000+ flats / homes; condo and EC developments with 12+ months since their first resale; HDB by HDB Property Information block positions

rankExcludingRecent.rule: areas with 1,000+ flats / homes; condo and EC developments with 12+ months since their first resale; HDB by HDB Property Information block positions

peerComparisons.note: 5th; joint 3rd with Queenstown, Rochor, Yishun, Jurong West

insights.text: 2,005 HDB flats and 484 condos resold in Tampines in the last 12 months.
insights.qualifier: October 2025 to September 2026. The 484 condo resales are all resales; the resale rate uses the 484 resales in the 21 developments for which URA records the number of homes.

insights.text: Tampines' 5-room flats resold at a median $810,000, 9% above Singapore's $740,000.
insights.qualifier: Median of 553 resales. Shown for context; it does not indicate what any buyer can afford.

insights.text: 53% of Tampines households earn $10,000 or more a month from work, above Singapore (50.5%).
insights.qualifier: Household income does not measure buying power or demand. Survey estimate from the General Household Survey 2025.
